In detail

Naples' eastern periphery and, on the current evidence, the most consistently dangerous part of the city. The Court of Appeal names "Barra-Ponticelli" among the highest-stese areas; a citywide count found 92 stese episodes across Naples and its province in 2024 (up from 59 in 2023), with San Giovanni a Teduccio named among the five most-affected zones. On 24 April 2025, in broad daylight, two gunmen fired twelve shots at Piazza Capri in San Giovanni a Teduccio in an ongoing feud between the Rinaldi and D'Amico clans (linked to the Mazzarella organisation) — days after gunfire had already interrupted a Good Friday procession in the same area. In April 2026 a 20-year-old was murdered in Ponticelli, triggering intensified Prefettura enforcement across the area on top of an already substantial 2025 campaign there (over 65 operations, 11,384 people checked, 237 reported, 76 arrests). This is red both day and night on the strength of a documented daylight shooting and a 2026 homicide, not a night-only judgement call. Sources checked: Fanpage.it, 26/28 Jun 2023, citing the Naples Court of Appeal report; Napolitan.it, 13 Apr 2025 (92 stese in 2024, zones named); Pupia.tv, 24 Apr 2025 (Piazza Capri daylight shooting); Positanonews.it, May 2024 (electoral exchange arrests, Ponticelli-Barra-San Giovanni); Fanpage.it, 7 Apr 2026 (Ponticelli homicide and 2025 enforcement statistics).
